name: schema_validator
description: Validate that SQL dialects (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL) and MongoDB document structures stay synchronized whenever database models change in the common/db backends.

model.description: The domain model whose persistence shape changed (e.g. IdentityProperties, IdentityStats, Profession).

dialects.description: Backends to check for synchronized schema.

stat_keys_source.description: Path to the StatKeys allow-list used to validate dynamic stat columns.

fail_on_drift.description: Return a non-zero result if any dialect diverges from the shared model.
